hotKeys.zh-CN: 快捷键组合：任意个修饰键加一个普通键，取值参考 KeyboardEvent.key。组合不合法时抛错，更新后同样校验。
hotKeys.en-US: The key combination: any number of modifiers plus one other key, as KeyboardEvent.key values. An invalid combination throws, including after an update.

content.zh-CN: 显示的按键文字，缺省显示 hotKeys。
content.en-US: Key labels to show. Defaults to hotKeys.

preventDefault.zh-CN: 是否阻止快捷键的默认行为。
preventDefault.en-US: Whether the default behavior of the key combination is prevented.

getListenerTarget.zh-CN: 返回监听 keydown 的元素；缺省或返回 null、undefined 时使用 document.body。
getListenerTarget.en-US: Returns the element that listens for keydown. When omitted, or when it returns null or undefined, document.body is used.

hotKey.zh-CN: 按下完整的快捷键组合时触发，参数为原生 KeyboardEvent。
hotKey.en-US: Emitted when the full key combination is pressed, with the native KeyboardEvent.

default.zh-CN: 替换按键提示的渲染。传入空插槽时不渲染任何元素，快捷键仍然有效。
default.en-US: Replaces the key hint. An empty slot renders nothing and the hot keys stay active.
